note: Original sample transcript written for TribeCode's tests (CC0).

lines.text: I played the cave level twice.
The lantern mechanic is really fun, I loved lighting the crystals one by one.
But the map was confusing because every tunnel looks the same color.
I got stuck at the bridge for a long time since the jump felt too short.
Yes, the game crashed once when I paused during the waterfall.
Okay. Kofi will give each tunnel its own color so the map reads better.
Let's make the bridge jump a bit longer and fix the pause crash before the next build.
The music in the crystal room was beautiful, keep that.

summary: The lantern mechanic is fun and the crystal room music is loved.
The map is confusing because tunnels look the same.
The bridge jump feels too short and the game crashed when pausing at the waterfall.
actions: Kofi: give each tunnel its own color
make the bridge jump a bit longer
